verdict.rationale: Probes show docs.solokeys.dev has no llms.txt and no markdown docs endpoint (both 404). The only llms.txt on solokeys.com is a shopping-agent file generated by the Shopify platform, not SoloKeys product or technical documentation. That is a host-platform artifact, so it earns no credit, and no agent-oriented documentation is evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
